mcqs.q: The historic Cellular Jail in Port Blair, where Indian freedom fighters were exiled, was infamously known by which name?
mcqs.questionText: The historic Cellular Jail in Port Blair, where Indian freedom fighters were exiled, was infamously known by which name?
mcqs.qHi: पोर्ट ब्लेयर की ऐतिहासिक सेलुलर जेल, जहाँ स्वतंत्रता सेनानियों को निर्वासित किया जाता था, को किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
mcqs.questionTextHi: पोर्ट ब्लेयर की ऐतिहासिक सेलुलर जेल, जहाँ स्वतंत्रता सेनानियों को निर्वासित किया जाता था, को किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
mcqs.exp: Cellular Jail was referred to as 'Kala Pani' (Black Waters) due to its remote isolation across the ocean.
mcqs.explanation: Cellular Jail was referred to as 'Kala Pani' (Black Waters) due to its remote isolation across the ocean.
mcqs.expHi: ब्रिटिश काल में 1906 में निर्मित सेलुलर जेल को इसके अत्यंत कठोर कारावास और एकांत कोठरियों के कारण 'काला पानी' कहा जाता था।

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Port Blair (Sri Vijaya Puram). Andaman and Nicobar Islands covers a geographic area of 8,249 sq km across 3 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Kalpong River (only river in Andaman, on North Andaman island).

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Archipelago of 572 islands in the Bay of Bengal and Andaman Sea. Home to the historic Cellular Jail (Kala Pani), Barren Island (South Asia's only active volcano), and indigenous tribes (Sentinelese, Jarawa, Onge, Shompen).

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Andaman and Nicobar Islands was formally instituted on 1 November 1956. Official language(s): Hindi, English.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Nicobari Dance, Great Andamanese dance.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Island Tourism Festival, Subhash Mela.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

facts.title: Lieutenant Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Lieutenant Governor is Admiral D. K. Joshi.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Calcutta High Court (Port Blair Circuit Bench).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Dugong (Sea cow) | State Bird: Andaman wood pigeon | State Flower: Andaman pyinma | State Tree: Andaman padauk.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Limestone, Silica sand.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Andaman and Nicobar Islands plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Cellular Jail National Memorial (Port Blair), Ross Island (Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Dweep), Viper Island Gallows.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park, Campbell Bay National Park, Galathea Bay, Mount Harriet (Mount Manipur).

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Andaman & Nicobar Island Integrated Development Scheme.
